skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of computer graphics, including 2D and 3D graphics, transformations, and rendering techniques.
Develop and implement computer graphics algorithms and applications using programming languages and libraries such as OpenGL.
Solve complex problems related to computer graphics through logical reasoning and algorithmic thinking.
Work effectively in teams to complete graphics-related projects and assignments.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and seek out additional resources to enhance understanding of computer graphics concepts.
Analyze and evaluate different approaches to solving graphics-related problems.
Effectively communicate ideas and solutions related to computer graphics through written and oral presentations.
